title: Principal Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
**Overview**

Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people around the world daily, and growing rapidly? Do you care deeply about how software is designed with a focus on supporting global scale? Do you want to be part of a world-class team that continuously pushes the boundary of service and engineering excellence?

The Office Web Shared Team is looking for a **Principal Software Engineer** who is passionate about working on high-scale geo-distributed WXP Shared Platform. Web Shared is gearing up for investment in world class fundamentals for Office apps like performance and reliability along with new Copilot value. If you want hands-on experience in designing, building, re-architecting the apps that truly impact the customers across the world at a scale not found often in the industry – this is the role for you.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Influence and create new designs and architectures.
* Performance benchmarking of Word, Excel, Power Point apps perf improvements by influencing architecture and designs.
* Have a passion for secure, reliable, scalable and maintainable code.
* Write code and test cases for feature development.
* Is able to identify new tech modernization opportunities, do quick POCs, showcase value and align partners on making it a successful platform / product.
* Defining new components with understanding of service interdependencies and limitations.
* Work effectively with multiple product development and engineering teams.
* You must be self-driven, curious to learn, proactive, result oriented, a thought leader having solid communication and influencing skills.
* Identifying opportunities to leveraging AI for making the organization more productive.
* Help build and foster a culture of Engineering Excellence.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
  + OR equivalent experience.

**Additional or preferred qualifications**

**Other Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably in cloud infrastructure management or web.
* Expertise in one and/or familiarity with Web development and programming languages, such as C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript/ TypeScript.
* Expert on performance, scalability, enterprise system architecture, and engineering best practices.
* Solid knowledge of software engineering principles, patterns, and practices, such as object-oriented design, test-driven development, and agile methodologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms and services, such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Deep interest in AI, machine learning, or data science, or related technologies.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Passion for learning new skills and technologies and sharing them with others.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft 365 brings together productivity applications and cloud services that empower people and organizations to create, communicate, and collaborate. PowerPoint is central to this mission, helping millions of people transform ideas into compelling stories and visually engaging presentations.The Microsoft 365 team is growing, and the PowerPoint organization is looking for talented engineers to help build the future of presentation creation. As a PowerPoint engineer, you will contribute to one of the world’s most widely used presentation products and deliver experiences that reach millions of customers.As a **Senior Software Engineer**, you will design and build features for PowerPoint for the web that help users create compelling stories and visually engaging presentations. You will define technical strategy, drive engineering excellence, and pioneer AI-powered innovations that shape the future of PowerPoint. Working with cross-functional partners, you will translate customer needs into robust, scalable experiences while improving performance and reliability through techniques such as lazy loading, caching, and asynchronous loading. If you are excited by complex technical challenges, broad cross-team influence, and the opportunity to transform how millions of people create presentations with AI, we would love to hear from you.This position provides an excellent opportunity for full-stack product development using AI, shaping the future of PowerPoint for the web, as we combine innovative front-end and back-end technologies with the power of cloud services to deliver an exceptional value for the users worldwide.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Design, develop, and improve large-scale system architecture and infrastructure.
* Design and develop complete features and experiences with high quality, evolving the service to scale and having world-class performance and reliability.
* You will be hands-on in implementation, debugging, shipping and mitigating incidents in live production environments.
* Write high quality code, complete with unit and integration tests.
* You will provide mentorship and coaching to team to help them identify and propose relevant solutions.
* Work closely with Product Management and Design disciplines to shape the infrastructure and product.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent.
* 6+ years of software development experience in C#, C++, .NET, TypeScript, or similar programming languages or platforms
* Proficiency in Data Structures and Algorithms
* Experience building and shipping production grade services.
* Track record of delivering products, features and functionality on time, with extremely high quality
* Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
* Good verbal and written communication skills and ability to work cross- team in collaborative environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with agentic engineering and AI-assisted coding across design, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review, with responsible validation and quality practices.
* Experience with Azure Cloud and ADO (Azure DevOps) pipeline is preferred but not required
* Experience with JavaScript/Typescript and HTML5 and familiarity with frameworks like React is a plus.
* Passion for building highly available products at scale.
* Self-driven, pro-active, results-oriented and ability to work with minimal direction
* Experience leading a multi-person team from design through implementation to delivery

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Frontend / Full Stack Developer
description:
**Frontend / Full Stack Developer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our services include cosmetic safety, regulatory compliance, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship and brand protection across international markets.

We are expanding our technology capabilities and are looking for a **Frontend / Full Stack Developer** to help create modern, responsive and scalable digital products and applications for GCRS.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing user\-facing applications while also having the ability to work across the backend where required.

You will work closely with UI/UX designers, backend developers, product stakeholders and business teams to turn concepts and requirements into functional digital products.

The role will involve building new features, improving existing applications, integrating APIs, troubleshooting technical issues and ensuring that our products provide a fast, intuitive and reliable user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop responsive and user\-friendly web applications
* Build reusable frontend components
* Convert UI/UX designs into functional interfaces
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs
* Develop and maintain application features
* Work with backend developers on full\-stack functionality
* Optimize applications for speed and performance
* Ensure compatibility across modern browsers and devices
* Identify and resolve frontend and application issues
* Write clean and maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
* Implement appropriate testing practices
* Work with designers to ensure accurate implementation of designs
* Collaboration with product and business stakeholders
* Maintain technical documentation where required
* Support deployment and maintenance of applications
* Improve accessibility and usability
* Contribute to frontend development standards
* Identify opportunities for automation and technical improvement

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a developer who combines strong front\-end skills with a broader understanding of full\-stack application development.

You should have a strong eye for detail and care about both technical quality and the user experience.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in frontend or full\-stack development
* Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Experience with React, Next.js, Vue or a similar modern framework
* Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs
* Understanding of responsive web design
* Knowledge of Git and version Control
* Understanding of browser compatibility and web performance
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of basic backend concepts
* Ability to work with databases and APIs
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to understand UI/UX designs and implement them accurately
* Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non\-technical teams

**Desirable Experience**

* TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL and other relational or modern database technologies.
* Hands\-on knowledge of cloud deployment, authentication and authorization systems.
* A background in developing dashboards and data\-intensive applications.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks and AI\-enabled application development

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Delivered high\-quality frontend features
* Improved existing interfaces and application performance
* Worked effectively with the UI/UX and backend teams
* Contributed to scalable frontend architecture
* Reduced recurring technical issues
* Improved the consistency and usability of our digital products
* Delivered projects within agreed timelines
* Contributed to a stronger development workflow

**Why Join Us?**

You will join a growing international organisation where technology is becoming an increasingly important part of our services and operations. You will have the opportunity to work on new products rather than simply maintaining legacy systems, with scope to grow into a senior developer, full\-stack or technical leadership role.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.

Work Location: In person
